P040.title: Random vibration analysis for train–track interaction from the aspect of uncertainty quantification
P040.authors: L Xu, Y Zhao, Z Li, B Yan, W Chen
P040.label: Xu等（2021）

complete_examples.text: Using uncertainty quantification approaches, the randomness of system geometries and longitudinal inhomogeneity of system properties can be simulated properly.

With an effort to reveal more reliable and realistic dynamic behaviours for the train–track system, researchers in railway engineering gradually realize that the role of uncertainty quantification of train–track interactions in system excitations and physical parameters should be reasonably considered.
